notes: One upload per file through Open Cloud POST /assets/v1/assets (owner approval 19 Nov 2026). Never re-upload a file listed here; reuse its id.
Raw inserts: ServerStorage.MeshImports.<displayName> (packages; never edit them). Templates: ServerStorage.WorldGen.WeaponsV3Assets.build().

axes: Roblox (x, y, z) = Blender (x, z, -y). Held items: Grip at the origin, look = item axis (Roblox +Y), up = edge / front (Roblox -Z), as WeaponsV2 / ItemsReal. Same grips and attachments as WeaponsV2.

stars.rule: Five meshes per weapon, <id>_t1 .. <id>_t5 (Combat_v3 5.1): same silhouette, detail grows inside it. Each part carries its own star finish in rgb / robloxMaterial: set them from this manifest (the importer drops colours). finishRole is the Stars.applyFinish role if a tint is still wanted; the variant colours already are the finish, so applyFinish should skip parts whose model has attribute Variant.

import: Held and far models: CanCollide/CanQuery/CanTouch off, CollisionFidelity Box, Massless, CastShadow off on viewmodel copies.
Metal parts: matte (Metal material with no reflectance, or SmoothPlastic as WeaponLooks does for plain parts so they never mirror the sky). Nothing Neon, nothing emissive.
paired_blades welds to RightGripAttachment, paired_blades_L to LeftGripAttachment (offHand = true).
leaf_dagger: FingerRing is the ring centre for the first-person flourish.
ring_blade is now 1.78 across (was 2.2): Tip and Spin moved with it.
Bows: hide <name>_Rope while drawing and draw Beams between StringTop, the Nock and StringBottom.
